decisions.reason: As a low-cost plugin very close to the core webshop service offer, it still retains niche option value and is cheap enough to keep available while the firm focuses investment elsewhere.

After several years, the learning value of another narrowly focused price-comparison tracking plugin is largely exhausted, and portfolio overlap makes continued retention less attractive than reallocating resources.
Given the redundancy among similar tracking plugins and the firm's shift toward broader multichannel development, management would now close this option rather than keep carrying it.
This product sits in an overlapping cluster where uncertainty should by now be sufficiently resolved, so real-options logic favors abandonment and redeployment of effort to stronger opportunities.
A net price reporting plugin is still adjacent to the firm's analytics and optimization capabilities, and its likely low maintenance burden justifies keeping the option open a bit longer.
